# `Human` — engine binding surface

- **`Human`** — retail table VA `0x00B99EF0`, 21 required cfuncs.

**GENERATED — do not edit by hand.** Regenerate with `cargo run -p mercs2_script --bin emmylua-gen`.

For IDE autocomplete on the same surface, load the paired EmmyLua stub — see `output/emmylua/mercs2/Human.lua` (regenerated by the same command).
